_comment_broadcast_hotkey: Global keyboard shortcut to mute laptop speaker and stream to all devices (toggle). Uses GNOME custom keybinding via gsettings. Set to "disabled" to turn off auto-registration. Default is <Control><Alt>b. Restart or SIGHUP after editing.
_comment: features: per-section flags. Any key absent (or whole block absent) defaults to true. Set a key false to hide the section and disable its dedicated backend endpoints. Restart the service after editing.
